suite.name: Automation Practice Hub - Manual Test Cases

section.name: UI Testing
section.description: User interface and workflow tests for Automation Practice Hub web application

section.name: Authentication
section.description: Login, credentials validation, Page Object Model integration, and data-driven login scenarios

case.title: Verify User Login with Valid Credentials (Standard Flow)

custom.preconds: 1. Web browser (Chrome/Edge/Firefox) is installed and has internet connectivity. 2. Web application is live and accessible at https://www.automationpracticehub.com/ 3. Valid credentials are available: - Username: sagesyntaxacademy - Password: BuildingExcellence@111

step.content: Navigate to application URL: https://www.automationpracticehub.com/
step.expected: Login page loads successfully and the address bar displays https://www.automationpracticehub.com/

step.content: Locate the 'Username' input field and enter 'sagesyntaxacademy'
step.expected: Username text field accepts and displays 'sagesyntaxacademy'

step.content: Locate the 'Password' input field and enter 'BuildingExcellence@111'
step.expected: Password field accepts input masked as bullets/dots

step.content: Click on the 'I Agree to the' Terms and Conditions checkbox
step.expected: Checkbox state changes to checked (selected)

step.content: Click the 'Sign In' button
step.expected: Authentication request succeeds and the user is redirected to the dashboard/home screen without errors

case.title: Verify Field Value Retention and POM Component Flow during Login

custom.preconds: 1. Application is online at https://www.automationpracticehub.com/ 2. Valid credentials known: sagesyntaxacademy / BuildingExcellence@111

step.content: Open login page via Page Object initialization (Loginpage.navigateToLoginPage)
step.expected: Browser navigates to https://www.automationpracticehub.com/

step.content: Enter Username 'sagesyntaxacademy' and Password 'BuildingExcellence@111'
step.expected: Input fields are populated with given test data

step.content: Verify element values for usernameField and passwordField prior to form submission
step.expected: usernameField has value 'sagesyntaxacademy'; passwordField has value 'BuildingExcellence@111'

step.content: Check Terms & Conditions and click 'Sign In' button
step.expected: Sign In is executed cleanly without client-side error notifications

case.title: Verify Landing Page Title after Successful Sign-In

custom.preconds: 1. User is on login page https://www.automationpracticehub.com/

step.content: Navigate to https://www.automationpracticehub.com/ and enter valid credentials
step.expected: Username and Password inputs are populated

step.content: Check 'I Agree to the' checkbox and click 'Sign In'
step.expected: User successfully logs into the application

step.content: Inspect the browser document title (document.title)
step.expected: Page title strictly equals: "Automation Practice Hub : A Sage Syntax Academy's product"

case.title: Verify Authentication using External Config and Excel Test Data

custom.preconds: 1. Configuration file (config/global.properties) defines BASE_URL=https://www.automationpracticehub.com/ 2. Excel sheet (test-data/userData.xlsx, sheet 'userDataSheet1') contains valid test records.

step.content: Read BASE_URL from configuration and navigate browser to the application
step.expected: Browser loads configured URL https://www.automationpracticehub.com/

step.content: Retrieve username from userData.js and password from userData.xlsx
step.expected: Data parsed accurately: username='sagesyntaxacademy', password='BuildingExcellence@111'

step.content: Populate username and password inputs with extracted values and verify values
step.expected: Fields match extracted values exactly

step.content: Select terms checkbox and click 'Sign In'
step.expected: Sign In request succeeds

step.content: Log test execution steps and capture screenshots before and after submission
step.expected: Screenshots and audit logs are recorded for verification

section.name: API Testing
section.description: REST API test cases targeting Reqres API endpoints

case.title: Verify Retrieval of Paginated User List via GET /api/users?page=1

custom.preconds: 1. REST API endpoint https://reqres.in is reachable

step.content: Send an HTTP GET request to https://reqres.in/api/users?page=1
step.expected: Request completes with HTTP status code 200 OK

step.content: Verify that the response body is formatted as valid JSON with pagination fields
step.expected: Response body contains: 'page', 'per_page', 'total', 'total_pages', and 'data' array

step.content: Inspect and validate the first object in the 'data' array (data[0])
step.expected: Assertions succeed: - id == 1 - email == 'george.bluth@reqres.in' - first_name == 'George' - last_name == 'Bluth'

custom.preconds: 1. REST API endpoint https://reqres.in is reachable

step.expected: JSON request body is properly formatted

step.content: Send HTTP POST request to https://reqres.in/api/users with payload
step.expected: Server responds with HTTP status code 201 Created

step.content: Parse response JSON and validate attributes: name, email, job, id, createdAt
step.expected: Response body confirms: - name == 'Name 1' - email == 'Name1@example.com' - job == 'Automation Test Engineer' - id is generated - createdAt timestamp is populated

custom.preconds: 1. REST API endpoint https://reqres.in is reachable 2. User with ID 2 exists

step.expected: Payload formatted properly

step.content: Send HTTP request to https://reqres.in/api/users/2 with payload
step.expected: Server responds with HTTP status code 201 (or 200)

step.content: Parse response JSON and validate attributes: name, email, job
step.expected: Response body confirms updated fields: - name == 'morpheus' - email == 'xyz@example.com' - job == 'zion resident'
